topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I keep thinking about how excited I was for this weekend. The plans seemed perfect, or so I thought. Friends talking about how surprised I'd be, the hints dropped casually. I imagined the moment, walking in, seeing everyone jump up, cheering. But now, the texts are different, filled with apologies and explanations that just don’t quite land. Maybe they had to work, or something came up. I keep looking at my phone, hoping for a new message, something that will bring back that sparkle of anticipation. I understand things happen, but it's hard to let go of the excitement that’s been building. I’ll find a way to make the best of it, but it won’t be the same.
